market_summary: Across all five instruments, the market is characterized by late London session low-volume consolidation. Gold, silver, and Bitcoin are trapped inside their respective session Value Areas around POC and EMA20 baselines with sub-1.0 RVOL. EURUSD and GBPUSD executed liquidity sweeps of their session lows against lower ATR envelopes, but are rebounding directly into heavy overhead confluence (VAL, EMA20, and descending VWAP) without expansion RVOL confirmation. All setups remain low-probability range chop, warranting a flat HOLD posture across the board until the New York cash open injects genuine institutional order flow.
